description:
Vast is developing next-generation space stations and space infrastructure using an incremental, hardware-rich, and low-cost approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven-1 is expected to become the world’s first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced Vast Satellite , a high-power satellite product line leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo.

 Headquartered in Long Beach, California , and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America’s next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long-term space economy.



 Vast is looking for an Avionics Test Software Engineer , reporting to the Staff Avionics Test Software Engineer , to support the development of the systems that will be required for the design and build of human-rated space stations.

 This will be a  full-time, exempt position located in our Long Beach location.

 Responsibilities:  

 
 Design and implement Python software for automated testing of flight-critical avionics hardware

 Manage the complete software lifecycle for avionics test systems, from initial development through qualification and acceptance testing of production hardware

 Integrate test equipment with avionics hardware under test, collaborating with Test Engineers and Avionics Responsible Engineers to resolve automation challenges

 Partner cross-functionally with hardware, test, and avionics teams to define test requirements and recommend test equipment solutions

 Create clear, comprehensive documentation and user guides for test engineer and technician handover

 Enhance and extend the existing Python test automation framework with new capabilities and tooling

 Diagnose and troubleshoot test anomalies, providing root cause analysis and resolution

 Conduct code reviews and drive accountability in following core software engineering principles

 
 Minimum Qualifications: 

 
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering or other engineering / physical science discipline

 Proficiency in Object-Oriented Programming with Python

 Experience writing software to interface with instrumentation hardware (e.g. power supplies, measurement equipment, etc) 

 Experience using Data Acquisition (DAQ) systems such as National Instruments or similar modular DAQ solutions

 Familiarity with software version control such as GitHub

 Experience with software unit testing and CI/CD

 Strong documentation and communication skills

 Proficiency in leveraging AI coding assistants and workflows to accelerate development, debug complex issues, and improve code quality

 
 Preferred Skills & Experience: 

 
 Familiarity with NASA SMC-S-016 test requirements and standards

 Experience with AWS services and cloud-based development tools

 Practical experience operating power supplies, electronic loads, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and digital multimeters

 Knowledge of electronic instrumentation drivers using SCPI and pyVISA

 Comfortable working in Linux environments with understanding of kernel software and device drivers

 Experience with embedded systems and C++ programming

 Experience with network protocols and communication standards (TCP/UDP, DHCP, Ethernet) for instrument control and data acquisition

 Experience building web-based user interfaces or dashboards for test visualization and control (React, Angular, or similar frameworks)

 
 Additional Requirements: 

 
 Willingness to work evenings and/or weekends to support critical mission milestones

 Pay Range: California
 $135,300 — $226,980 USD 


 
 We calibrate level and compensation to the selected candidate's experience and demonstrated capability. We welcome applicants across a range of experience levels to apply. 

  

 COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS
 
Base salary will vary depending on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, business needs, and market demand. Salary is just one component of our comprehensive compensation package. Full-time employees also receive company equity, as well as access to a full suite of compelling benefits and perks, including: medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, generous paid time off; up to 20+ days of vacation for exempt staff and up to 10+ days of vacation for non-exempt staff with the ability to cash-out unused vacation annually, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, ClassPass credits, personalized mental healthcare through Spring Health, and other discounts and perks. We also take pride in offering exceptional food perks, with snacks, drip coffee & onsite barista, cold drinks, and dinner meals remaining free of charge, and lunch subsidized as part of Vast’s ongoing commitment to providing high-quality meals for employees.

 
U.S. EXPORT CONTROL COMPLIANCE STATUS

 The person hired will have access to information and items subject to U.S. export controls, and therefore, must either be a “U.S. person” as defined by  22 C.F.R. § 120.62 or otherwise eligible for deemed export licensing. This status includes U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, lawful permanent residents (green card holders), and asylees and refugees with such status granted, not pending.



 EQUAL OPPORTUNITY 

Vast is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Vast is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.
